credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, but the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} as personnel costs rose after the collective bargaining agreements.
Total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, leaving gross leverage stable at {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.

Interest coverage weakened by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, and operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} on krone weakness against the dollar.
FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, but FFO to debt slipped by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} as debt rose faster than cash generation.

Free cash flow rose by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, lifting FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, although capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity rose by {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue nevertheless fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, as revenue rose faster than the cash balance.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of liquidity is customers' prepayments.
Financing terms for upcoming aircraft deliveries improved, with the company securing its best terms for part of its order book.

peer_positioning.text: Norwegian sits in the middle of the low-cost group on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2024}}), net leverage ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2024}}) and FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}).

Gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} is the lowest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} is the strongest ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}), above the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2024}}.

Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2024}}, while cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} ranks {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}} against a median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@2024}}.
Advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is the lowest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2024}}), below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2024}}.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} is the weakest of the low-cost peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}), leaving less of a buffer relative to revenue.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and interest coverage fell by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2024}}, so a slowdown in bookings would hit cash sooner than at peers.
Capital returns: the Board intends to propose a profit distribution to shareholders, subject to approval from debt instrument holders.
